messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: metric service-inference.high_p99_latency crossed threshold (5m window) in us-west-2. p99 ~ 3200ms, p95 ~ 1200ms. PagerDuty incident pd_0234 fired. https://dashboards.redwood.internal/ops/latency

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident 'High tail latency - us-west-2' created (pd_0234). Please acknowledge and triage.

asha (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall for the next hour. Starting fast triage — any recent runtime deploys? :eyes:

riley: No runtime deploys in last 2h. Dashboards show p95 rising and p99 tail ballooning. Heatmap points to router + kv-cache evictions around 1840009900.

samira: looking now — KV evictions spiked at 1840009898, batcher-sidecar CPU spiking at same time. Logs: ```sidecar: warn: evicting key cust-42-hot-ctx (size 12MB)```. Paging infra to confirm.

pagerduty: PD: Reminder to update incident status in PD and add customer impact notes if needed.

marco: Observed a sudden burst of concurrent requests from cust-42 with long contexts and hotkey patterns. Router shows heavy fanout to the long-context path. No deploys.

asha (oncall): Ok — plan: 1) temporarily rate-limit/blacklist offending route for cust-42, 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs, 3) warm KV cache with small warmup script, 4) canary fallback to low-latency model if p99 stays high. Applying routing change now. :hammer_and_wrench:

asha (oncall): Command pushed: ```kubectl exec -n inference deploy/router -- curl -X POST http://router.internal/config -d '{"route_overrides": [{"match":"/v1/generate?customer=cust-42","action":"throttle","rate":10}]}'``` (will roll out safely).

samira: KV eviction rate down 60% after throttle. Warmup script running: ```python tools/warm_kv.py --keys-file=/tmp/cust42_hotkeys.txt --region=us-west-2```

riley: Rolling a canary to switch low-latency tier to model 'gpt-medium-quant' for a subset of routes to reduce token latency. Canary started (10% traffic).

samira: p95 dropped 1.2s -> 450ms within 90s. p99 trending down but still ~2.6s. Evictions stabilized.

asha (oncall): Notifying support + status team: posting incident note (partial degradation for long-context routes; active mitigation). Will update PD with impact and set 1h handoff to next oncall if stable.

marco: If p99 not under SLO in 15m, escalate to SRE lead and consider temporary model-routing default to small-ctx variant for all heavy customers.

asha (oncall): Agreed. Adding checkpoint: next update at 1840010600 or sooner on any regression. Keeping thread for live updates. :white_check_mark:

samira: PD acknowledged and tagged escalation policy. Continuing to monitor — leaving warmup running for another 10m.

riley: Canary looks healthy, no errors. Preparing rollback plan for throttle if customers complain. Link to live dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/ops/latency?range=15m

asha (oncall): Thanks team. If p99 < 1s for 10m, we'll close PD and switch to monitoring-only. Otherwise handoff to next oncall with notes.
